unresolved_field_definition: Every field ID in the frozen SPECS inventory that is absent from candidate_field_ids remains unresolved; no omission or structural inapplicability is asserted.
reviewer_decisions: Verify the VX-880 Parts A/B/C target mapping and exclude VX-017 Part D from all candidate dispositions.
Retain the structured Phase 3 value and separate master-protocol title descriptions; resolve the apparent phase framing only through human source review.
Preserve each planned endpoint's exact part, definition, source time frame, and anchor. In particular, do not treat one year after achieving insulin independence as a first-infusion horizon.
Do not convert 'one year' or Day 90 into an unreported fixed numeric visit or endpoint denominator.
Keep estimated enrollment 57 as mixed-protocol context only; it is not actual target enrollment or an endpoint denominator.
Confirm no results module is present in this approved version; do not treat that fact as a clinical failure.
